events.title: Tupac Shakur's death anniversary
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, American rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, dying six days later on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Tupac Shakur, whose profound impact on music and culture continues to resonate. His artistry challenged, inspired, and shaped a generation.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix death anniversary
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix died in London on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27 from barbiturate-related asphyxia, widely regarded as one of the greatest and most influential guitarists of all time.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, who redefined the electric guitar and left an indelible mark on music history. His groundbreaking sound continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', was released in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released today in 1969. That cover, those tracks – pure genius. What's your favourite from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead vocalist and songwriter for The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, in Akron, Ohio.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders! Still rocking and inspiring after all these years.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972, in Manchester, England.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The iconic frontman who gave us some of the biggest anthems of the 90s and beyond. As you were!

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine release anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in the United States in October 1971, from his album of the same name which was released on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Release
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace and unity that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod released anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember when your entire music library fit in your pocket? The first iPod was released this month in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic theme tunes to thrilling gadgets, which 007 film or song is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide. Imagine...

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, the acclaimed English actor, comedian, and screenwriter known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy, from Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that still sparks debate and delight. What's your top track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury death anniversary
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

events.title: John Lennon death anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, was tragically killed on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembrance
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who we lost on this day in 1980. His legacy as a musician, songwriter, and peace activist lives on.
